scope: regular-season games, pooled across seasons; correlations per player

weighting.scheme: per-game season weights (recency tilt); weighted Pearson, Kish effective-N used for significance
weighting.centering: pooled r's are within-season: each stat is centered on its season mean before pooling

short_game_rule.note: games under this fraction of the player's median minutes that season are flagged short in recent_games; they count in the r values and box means (props are action in them)

shrinkage.method: empirical Bayes: weighted r shrunk toward rotation players with a similar covariate value; noise evaluated at the prior
